sentences.zh: 你有空的話，我們一起去吃飯吧。
sentences.en: If you are free, let's go eat together.

sentences.zh: 明天下雨的話，我就不去公園。
sentences.en: If it rains tomorrow, I won't go to the park.

sentences.zh: 如果你想去臺灣的話，可以先學中文。
sentences.en: If you want to go to Taiwan, you can study Chinese first.

sentences.zh: 要是你不喜歡的話，可以換一個。
sentences.en: If you don't like it, you can swap it for another.

sentences.zh: 你太累的話，就休息一下吧。
sentences.en: If you are too tired, take a short rest.

sentences.zh: 他願意的話，我們可以合作。
sentences.en: If he is willing, we can cooperate.

sentences.zh: 如果天氣不錯的話，我想去海邊。
sentences.en: If the weather is good, I want to go to the beach.

sentences.zh: 你喜歡牛肉的話，可以試試看牛肉麵。
sentences.en: If you like beef, you can try beef noodle soup.

sentences.zh: 除了咖啡，我還喜歡喝茶。
sentences.en: Besides coffee, I also like to drink tea.

sentences.zh: 哥哥除了喜歡游泳，還喜歡爬山。
sentences.en: Besides swimming, my older brother also likes hiking.

sentences.zh: 除了會說中文，他也會說德文。
sentences.en: Besides speaking Chinese, he also speaks German.

sentences.zh: 我們公司除了在臺灣，也在美國有分公司。
sentences.en: Besides Taiwan, our company also has a branch in the U.S.

sentences.zh: 除了週末，平常我也去跑步。
sentences.en: Besides weekends, I also go running on weekdays.

sentences.zh: 她除了寫論文，還要找工作。
sentences.en: Besides writing her thesis, she has to look for a job.

sentences.zh: 除了牛肉麵，臺灣還有很多好吃的小吃。
sentences.en: Besides beef noodle soup, Taiwan has many other tasty snacks.

sentences.zh: 除了老師，我們也請了張家安。
sentences.en: Besides the teacher, we also invited Joann Zhang.

sentences.zh: 請你把房間整理整理。
sentences.en: Please tidy up the room.

sentences.zh: 請你把這件衣服洗一洗。
sentences.en: Please wash this piece of clothing.

sentences.zh: 請你把合約看一看。
sentences.en: Please take a look over the contract.

sentences.zh: 麻煩你把桌子擦擦。
sentences.en: Could you wipe the table, please?

sentences.zh: 請你把資料檢查檢查。
sentences.en: Please check the materials.

sentences.zh: 請你把麵包烤一烤再吃。
sentences.en: Please toast the bread before you eat it.

sentences.zh: 你把這個計畫想想，好不好？
sentences.en: Think over this plan, okay?

sentences.zh: 請你把院子打掃打掃。
sentences.en: Please tidy up the yard.

sentences.zh: 臺北夏天的天氣熱得不得了。
sentences.en: The summer weather in Taipei is unbelievably hot.

sentences.zh: 我今天忙得不得了。
sentences.en: I am extremely busy today.

sentences.zh: 飛機上的人多得不得了。
sentences.en: The plane was incredibly full of people.

sentences.zh: 他高興得不得了。
sentences.en: He is overjoyed.

sentences.zh: 這個行李重得不得了。
sentences.en: This luggage is extremely heavy.

sentences.zh: 我餓得不得了。
sentences.en: I am starving.

sentences.zh: 我先去拿行李，再去搭捷運。
sentences.en: I'll get my luggage first and then take the MRT.

sentences.zh: 我們先換錢，再去吃飯。
sentences.en: We'll exchange money first and then eat.

sentences.zh: 他先吃飯，再看電視。
sentences.en: He eats first and then watches TV.

sentences.zh: 先右轉，再往前走。
sentences.en: Turn right first, then go straight.

sentences.zh: 你先休息一下，再工作吧。
sentences.en: Rest a little first, then work.

sentences.zh: 我先給老闆打電話，再回家。
sentences.en: I'll call my boss first and then go home.

sentences.zh: 我一點都不餓。
sentences.en: I'm not hungry at all.

sentences.zh: 他一點也不累。
sentences.en: He isn't tired at all.

sentences.zh: 這個行李一點都不重。
sentences.en: This luggage isn't heavy at all.

sentences.zh: 我一點時間也沒有。
sentences.en: I have no time at all.

sentences.zh: 今天一點都不冷。
sentences.en: It's not cold at all today.

sentences.zh: 她一點都不緊張。
sentences.en: She isn't nervous at all.

sentences.zh: 我一點也不想吃飯。
sentences.en: I don't feel like eating at all.

sentences.zh: 從這裡往前走，就是機場。
sentences.en: Go straight ahead from here and you'll reach the airport.

sentences.zh: 請往左轉。
sentences.en: Please turn left.

sentences.zh: 你往右轉，就可以看到停車場。
sentences.en: Turn right and you will see the parking lot.

sentences.zh: 請往前走，不要往後走。
sentences.en: Please go forward, not backward.

sentences.zh: 他往上走。
sentences.en: He goes up.

sentences.zh: 我想租公寓，另外，也想買一些家具。
sentences.en: I want to rent an apartment; in addition, I'd like to buy some furniture.

sentences.zh: 這間房子很安靜，另外，離捷運站也很近。
sentences.en: This place is quiet; also, it is close to the MRT station.

sentences.zh: 我今天要去超市，另外，也要去銀行。
sentences.en: Today I have to go to the supermarket; also, to the bank.

sentences.zh: 房租不貴，另外，水費和電費也不用付。
sentences.en: The rent isn't expensive; also, no water or electricity bill to pay.

sentences.zh: 我先打掃房間，另外，還要整理書房。
sentences.en: I'll clean the room first; also, I still need to tidy the study.

sentences.zh: 公寓裡有電視，另外，還有冰箱。
sentences.en: The apartment has a TV; in addition, there is a refrigerator.

sentences.zh: 這間公寓算是很乾淨。
sentences.en: This apartment counts as quite clean.

sentences.zh: 這裡的房租算是便宜的。
sentences.en: The rent here counts as cheap.

sentences.zh: 這家便利商店算是大的。
sentences.en: This convenience store counts as a big one.

sentences.zh: 這個巷子不算安靜。
sentences.en: This alley isn't really quiet.

sentences.zh: 他不算有名，可是很多人認識他。
sentences.en: He isn't exactly famous, but many people know him.

sentences.zh: 我們公司算是小的。
sentences.en: Our company counts as a small one.

sentences.zh: 房子很舊，再加上沒有電梯，所以很不方便。
sentences.en: The house is old and has no elevator on top of that, so it's inconvenient.

sentences.zh: 這裡很安靜，再加上離捷運站很近，所以我很滿意。
sentences.en: It's quiet here and near the MRT besides, so I'm satisfied.

sentences.zh: 租金很貴，再加上水費和電費，所以我不想租。
sentences.en: The rent is high and the water and electricity bills on top, so I don't want to rent.

sentences.zh: 工作很忙，再加上壓力很大，他生病了。
sentences.en: Work is busy and the pressure on top of that made him sick.

sentences.zh: 天氣很冷，再加上下雨，我不想出去。
sentences.en: It's cold and raining on top of that; I don't want to go out.

sentences.zh: 他很年輕，再加上很認真，所以老闆很喜歡他。
sentences.en: He is young and earnest on top of that, so the boss likes him.

sentences.zh: 等朋友都來了，我們再開始吧。
sentences.en: Let's start once all our friends have arrived.

sentences.zh: 等你有空，我們再去看房子。
sentences.en: When you are free, we'll go look at houses.

sentences.zh: 等電梯好了，我再搬進去。
sentences.en: I'll move in once the elevator is fixed.

sentences.zh: 等我吃完飯，再給你打電話。
sentences.en: After I finish eating, I'll call you.

sentences.zh: 你等一下，我看完了再告訴你。
sentences.en: Wait a moment; I'll tell you once I've finished reading.

sentences.zh: 等房租付完了，再說吧。
sentences.en: Let's talk once the rent has been paid.

sentences.zh: 雞腿便當賣完了，王小姐才買雞肉三明治。
sentences.en: The chicken-leg boxed meals sold out, and only then did Miss Wang buy a chicken sandwich.

sentences.zh: 你先寫完作業，才可以看電視。
sentences.en: You can watch TV only after you finish your homework.

sentences.zh: 要有悠遊卡，才能坐捷運。
sentences.en: You need an EasyCard in order to ride the MRT.

sentences.zh: 他說了三次，我才聽懂。
sentences.en: He said it three times before I understood.

sentences.zh: 你告訴我，我才知道。
sentences.en: I know only because you told me.

sentences.zh: 公車十點才來，所以我晚一點才到。
sentences.en: The bus only comes at ten, so I will arrive a bit later.

sentences.zh: 一定要準時，才可以參加。
sentences.en: You must be on time to be allowed to join.

sentences.zh: 他買了車票，才上火車。
sentences.en: He bought a ticket and only then got on the train.

sentences.zh: 你先吃藥，才會好。
sentences.en: You will get better only after you take medicine.

sentences.zh: 他在臺灣住了十年，難怪中文說得這麼好。
sentences.en: He lived in Taiwan for ten years; no wonder his Chinese is so good.

sentences.zh: 難怪你這麼累，你昨天工作到很晚。
sentences.en: No wonder you're so tired; you worked until late yesterday.

sentences.zh: 今天塞車，難怪你遲到了。
sentences.en: There is a traffic jam today; no wonder you're late.

sentences.zh: 他是主管，難怪這麼忙。
sentences.en: He is a supervisor; no wonder he is so busy.

sentences.zh: 這家店的便當很便宜，難怪人很多。
sentences.en: The boxed meals at this shop are cheap; no wonder there are so many people.

sentences.zh: 天氣這麼冷，難怪你感冒了。
sentences.en: It is so cold; no wonder you caught a cold.

sentences.zh: 難怪他不來，他生病了。
sentences.en: No wonder he isn't coming; he is sick.

sentences.zh: 他每天都用功，難怪成績這麼好。
sentences.en: He studies hard every day; no wonder his grades are so good.

sentences.zh: 你想吃什麼，就吃什麼。
sentences.en: Eat whatever you want.

sentences.zh: 他想去哪裡，就去哪裡。
sentences.en: He goes wherever he wants.

sentences.zh: 我想買什麼，就買什麼。
sentences.en: I buy whatever I want.

sentences.zh: 你想怎麼走，就怎麼走。
sentences.en: Go whichever way you like.

sentences.zh: 誰想去，誰就去。
sentences.en: Whoever wants to go, goes.

sentences.zh: 你喜歡哪一個，就選哪一個。
sentences.en: Choose whichever one you like.

sentences.zh: 想喝什麼，就點什麼。
sentences.en: Order whatever you want to drink.

sentences.zh: 你要幾個，我就給你幾個。
sentences.en: However many you want, I'll give you that many.

sentences.zh: 夜市的小吃，我早就吃過了。
sentences.en: The night market snacks, I tried them long ago.

sentences.zh: 房子我們早就租好了。
sentences.en: We rented the house a long time ago.

sentences.zh: 他早就到了，你怎麼還沒來？
sentences.en: He arrived long ago; why haven't you come yet?

sentences.zh: 這個消息，我早就知道了。
sentences.en: This news, I knew it long ago.

sentences.zh: 我早就說過了，你不聽。
sentences.en: I said so long ago and you didn't listen.

sentences.zh: 他早就回家了。
sentences.en: He went home long ago.

sentences.zh: 放心，他一定會準時來的。
sentences.en: Don't worry, he will surely come on time.

sentences.zh: 你不用擔心，一切都會好的。
sentences.en: You don't need to worry; everything will be fine.

sentences.zh: 明天不會下雨的。
sentences.en: It won't rain tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 這家店的臭豆腐，你一定會喜歡的。
sentences.en: You will definitely like the stinky tofu at this shop.

sentences.zh: 他會幫你的。
sentences.en: He will help you.

sentences.zh: 我會好好學的。
sentences.en: I will study properly.

sentences.zh: 對學生來說，夜市很有意思。
sentences.en: For students, night markets are interesting.

sentences.zh: 對我來說，臭豆腐太臭了。
sentences.en: For me, stinky tofu is too smelly.

sentences.zh: 對老闆來說，時間很重要。
sentences.en: For a boss, time is important.

sentences.zh: 對外國人來說，漢字不容易。
sentences.en: For foreigners, Chinese characters are not easy.

sentences.zh: 對他來說，這個工作很容易。
sentences.en: For him, this job is easy.

sentences.zh: 對很多人來說，夜市是休閒的地方。
sentences.en: For many people, night markets are a place to relax.

sentences.zh: 不管天氣怎麼樣，夜市都很熱鬧。
sentences.en: No matter the weather, the night market is lively.

sentences.zh: 不管你想吃什麼，這裡都有。
sentences.en: No matter what you want to eat, they have it here.

sentences.zh: 不管多忙，他都準時下班。
sentences.en: No matter how busy, he gets off work on time.

sentences.zh: 不管你去不去，我都要去。
sentences.en: Whether you go or not, I'm going.

sentences.zh: 不管是臭豆腐還是雞排，我都敢吃。
sentences.en: Whether it's stinky tofu or chicken cutlet, I dare to eat it.

sentences.zh: 夜市的雞排酥酥脆脆的，真好吃。
sentences.en: The chicken cutlets at the night market are crispy and delicious.

sentences.zh: 熱熱的珍珠奶茶最好喝。
sentences.en: Hot pearl milk tea is the tastiest.

sentences.zh: 這杯木瓜牛奶甜甜的。
sentences.en: This papaya milk is sweet.

sentences.zh: 臭豆腐臭臭的，可是很香。
sentences.en: Stinky tofu smells strong but is fragrant.

sentences.zh: 他給我一杯冰冰的飲料。
sentences.en: He gave me an ice-cold drink.

sentences.zh: 房間小小的，很乾淨。
sentences.en: The room is small and very clean.

sentences.zh: 我在臺灣住了兩個月了。
sentences.en: I have lived in Taiwan for two months now.

sentences.zh: 他已經學了一年中文了。
sentences.en: He has already been studying Chinese for a year.

sentences.zh: 我已經等了二十分鐘了。
sentences.en: I've already been waiting for twenty minutes.

sentences.zh: 她在這家公司工作了三年了。
sentences.en: She has worked at this company for three years now.

sentences.zh: 他們已經看了兩個鐘頭電視了。
sentences.en: They have already watched TV for two hours.

sentences.zh: 我已經休息了三天了。
sentences.en: I have already rested for three days.

sentences.zh: 蛋糕的味道跟水果的品質有關係。
sentences.en: The flavor of the cake is related to the quality of the fruit.

sentences.zh: 身體健康跟運動有關係。
sentences.en: Good health is related to exercise.

sentences.zh: 這件事跟我沒有關係。
sentences.en: This matter has nothing to do with me.

sentences.zh: 個性跟天氣有關係嗎？
sentences.en: Is personality related to the weather?

sentences.zh: 學習成績跟用功有關。
sentences.en: Grades are related to hard work.

sentences.zh: 臺灣小吃受歡迎跟夜市有關係。
sentences.en: The popularity of Taiwanese snacks has to do with night markets.

sentences.zh: 他們在捷運站排著隊。
sentences.en: They are queuing at the MRT station.

sentences.zh: 她穿著白色的外套。
sentences.en: She is wearing a white coat.

sentences.zh: 他拿著一杯珍珠奶茶。
sentences.en: He is holding a cup of pearl milk tea.

sentences.zh: 我們站著等車。
sentences.en: We stand waiting for the bus.

sentences.zh: 他看著電視吃飯。
sentences.en: He eats while watching TV.

sentences.zh: 媽媽聽著音樂做飯。
sentences.en: Mom cooks while listening to music.

sentences.zh: 跟臺北比起來，這個城市比較安靜。
sentences.en: Compared with Taipei, this city is quieter.

sentences.zh: 跟走路比起來，坐捷運快多了。
sentences.en: Compared with walking, the MRT is much faster.

sentences.zh: 跟夏天比起來，我比較喜歡冬天。
sentences.en: Compared with summer, I prefer winter.

sentences.zh: 跟去餐廳吃飯比起來，自己做飯比較便宜。
sentences.en: Compared with eating out, cooking yourself is cheaper.

sentences.zh: 跟爬山比起來，我更喜歡游泳。
sentences.en: Compared with hiking, I like swimming even more.

sentences.zh: 我等了半個鐘頭才上車。
sentences.en: I waited half an hour before I got on.

sentences.zh: 他寫了三天才寫完。
sentences.en: It took him three days to finish writing.

sentences.zh: 我們走了二十分鐘才到。
sentences.en: It took us twenty minutes to get there on foot.

sentences.zh: 他學了兩年才說得流利。
sentences.en: It took him two years to speak fluently.

sentences.zh: 我找了很久才找到。
sentences.en: I searched for a long time before I found it.

sentences.zh: 王先生從來沒喝過酒。
sentences.en: Mr. Wang has never had alcohol.

sentences.zh: 我從來沒去過KTV。
sentences.en: I have never been to a KTV.

sentences.zh: 他從來不遲到。
sentences.en: He is never late.

sentences.zh: 我從來沒看過美式足球比賽。
sentences.en: I have never watched an American football game.

sentences.zh: 弟弟從來不喝咖啡。
sentences.en: My younger brother never drinks coffee.

sentences.zh: 她從來沒有忘記過我的生日。
sentences.en: She has never forgotten my birthday.

sentences.zh: 我本來不喜歡足球，後來變成球迷了。
sentences.en: I didn't like soccer at first, but later I became a fan.

sentences.zh: 我本來想去海邊，現在想在家休息。
sentences.en: I originally wanted to go to the beach; now I want to rest at home.

sentences.zh: 他本來是我的同事，後來變成我的男朋友。
sentences.en: He was originally my colleague and later became my boyfriend.

sentences.zh: 我本來不喜歡唱歌，現在常去KTV。
sentences.en: I didn't like singing before; now I often go to KTV.

sentences.zh: 本來我想坐捷運，後來坐了計程車。
sentences.en: I wanted to take the MRT but ended up taking a taxi.

sentences.zh: 本來天氣很好，後來下雨了。
sentences.en: The weather was fine at first, but later it rained.

sentences.zh: 只要你願意，我就幫你。
sentences.en: As long as you are willing, I will help you.

sentences.zh: 只要有手機，就不會迷路。
sentences.en: As long as you have a phone, you won't get lost.

sentences.zh: 只要大家努力，我們就會贏。
sentences.en: As long as everyone works hard, we will win.

sentences.zh: 只要有時間，我就去運動場跑步。
sentences.en: Whenever I have time, I go running at the sports ground.

sentences.zh: 只要你喜歡，就買吧。
sentences.en: As long as you like it, buy it.

sentences.zh: 只要多聽多說，你的中文就會進步。
sentences.en: As long as you listen and speak a lot, your Chinese will improve.

sentences.zh: 他們在個性上很不一樣。
sentences.en: They are very different in personality.

sentences.zh: 在生活上，他沒有問題。
sentences.en: In daily life, he has no problems.

sentences.zh: 這兩家店在價錢上差不多。
sentences.en: These two shops are about the same in price.

sentences.zh: 我們在工作上互相幫忙。
sentences.en: We help each other in our work.

sentences.zh: 在學習上，她很認真。
sentences.en: As far as study goes, she is very earnest.

sentences.zh: 亞洲人和歐洲人在吃飯的習慣上不同。
sentences.en: Asians and Europeans differ in eating habits.

sentences.zh: 從下個月起，公司不用加班了。
sentences.en: From next month on, the company doesn't need overtime.

sentences.zh: 從今天開始，我要多運動。
sentences.en: Starting today, I'm going to exercise more.

sentences.zh: 從小時候起，我就愛看書。
sentences.en: Since I was little, I have loved reading.

sentences.zh: 從明年起，我們要搬到臺北。
sentences.en: From next year, we will move to Taipei.

sentences.zh: 從星期一開始，我每天早起。
sentences.en: From Monday on, I get up early every day.

sentences.zh: 從這個月起，房租要貴一點。
sentences.en: From this month on, the rent will be a bit higher.

sentences.zh: 夜市的小吃很受歡迎，尤其是雞排。
sentences.en: Night market snacks are popular, especially chicken cutlets.

sentences.zh: 我喜歡運動，尤其是游泳。
sentences.en: I like sports, especially swimming.

sentences.zh: 臺灣的夏天很熱，尤其是七月。
sentences.en: Summers in Taiwan are hot, especially July.

sentences.zh: 這個城市有很多寺廟，尤其是在東區。
sentences.en: This city has many temples, especially in the eastern district.

sentences.zh: 他們的婚禮很熱鬧，尤其是敬酒的時候。
sentences.en: Their wedding was lively, especially during the toast.

sentences.zh: 我喜歡吃甜的，尤其是蛋糕。
sentences.en: I like sweet things, especially cake.

sentences.zh: 他連中文都不會說。
sentences.en: He can't even speak Chinese.

sentences.zh: 我連一杯咖啡也沒喝。
sentences.en: I didn't even drink a cup of coffee.

sentences.zh: 她太忙了，連吃飯都沒時間。
sentences.en: She is so busy she doesn't even have time to eat.

sentences.zh: 這個字很容易，連小孩子都認識。
sentences.en: This character is easy; even children know it.

sentences.zh: 他連自己的生日都忘記了。
sentences.en: He even forgot his own birthday.

sentences.zh: 連老師都不知道。
sentences.en: Even the teacher doesn't know.

sentences.zh: 你看得出來他是誰嗎？
sentences.en: Can you tell who he is?

sentences.zh: 我聽不出來這是什麼歌。
sentences.en: I can't tell what song this is.

sentences.zh: 我想不出來他的名字。
sentences.en: I can't think of his name.

sentences.zh: 你認得出來嗎？
sentences.en: Can you recognize it?

sentences.zh: 他穿上禮服，我認不出來是誰。
sentences.en: He put on formal clothes and I couldn't recognize who it was.

sentences.zh: 我看得出來你很高興。
sentences.en: I can see that you are very happy.

sentences.zh: 這個菜我吃得出來有點酸。
sentences.en: I can taste that this dish is a bit sour.

sentences.zh: 我們吃完飯，各付各的。
sentences.en: After the meal, we each pay for ourselves.

sentences.zh: 這些族群的語言不同，各有各的風俗。
sentences.en: The languages of these groups differ; each has its own customs.

sentences.zh: 烏龍茶有很多種，各有各的味道。
sentences.en: Oolong tea comes in many kinds, each with its own flavor.

sentences.zh: 我跟哥哥生活習慣不同，所以各住各的。
sentences.en: My older brother and I have different living habits, so we each live on our own.

sentences.zh: 大家喜歡吃的不一樣，各吃各的。
sentences.en: Everyone likes different foods, so we each eat our own.

sentences.zh: 這幾個部落各有各的祭典。
sentences.en: These villages each have their own festival.

sentences.zh: 同事下班以後，大家各走各的。
sentences.en: After work, the colleagues each go their own way.

sentences.zh: 兩個人的想法不同，各做各的。
sentences.en: The two have different ideas, so each does their own thing.

sentences.zh: 臺灣小吃很多，像雞排、臭豆腐、珍珠奶茶等，都很受歡迎。
sentences.en: Taiwan has many snacks, like chicken cutlets, stinky tofu and pearl milk tea, all popular.

sentences.zh: 他喜歡的運動有足球、籃球、棒球等。
sentences.en: The sports he likes include soccer, basketball, baseball and so on.

sentences.zh: 這裡的景點有阿里山、日月潭、墾丁等。
sentences.en: The scenic spots here include Alishan, Sun Moon Lake, Kenting and others.

sentences.zh: 花蓮、臺東、屏東等地方，有很多原住民族。
sentences.en: In Hualien, Taitung, Pingtung and other places there are many indigenous peoples.

sentences.zh: 我學過中文、德文、英文等。
sentences.en: I have studied Chinese, German, English and so on.

sentences.zh: 夜市有雞排、臭豆腐、木瓜牛奶等。
sentences.en: The night market has chicken cutlets, stinky tofu, papaya milk and more.

sentences.zh: 他的朋友有老師、醫生、經理等。
sentences.en: His friends include teachers, doctors, managers and so on.

sentences.zh: 公司在美國、德國、日本等地方都有分公司。
sentences.en: The company has branches in the U.S., Germany, Japan and other places.

sentences.zh: 你生病了，非去醫院不可。
sentences.en: You are sick; you absolutely must go to the hospital.

sentences.zh: 明天的考試，我非準備好不可。
sentences.en: For tomorrow's test, I absolutely have to be prepared.

sentences.zh: 要學好中文，非多練習不可。
sentences.en: To learn Chinese well, you must practise a lot.

sentences.zh: 他非去花蓮不可。
sentences.en: He insists on going to Hualien.

sentences.zh: 這個景點很有名，我們非去看看不可。
sentences.en: This spot is famous; we must go and see it.

sentences.zh: 想要成績好，非用功不可。
sentences.en: To get good grades, you must work hard.

sentences.zh: 這件事非告訴老闆不可。
sentences.en: We must tell the boss about this.

sentences.zh: 來臺灣，非吃夜市的小吃不可。
sentences.en: If you come to Taiwan, you must eat night market snacks.

sentences.zh: 學中文給我帶來更多機會。
sentences.en: Studying Chinese brings me more opportunities.

sentences.zh: 這段經驗給我帶來很多回憶。
sentences.en: This experience has brought me many memories.

sentences.zh: 夜市給人們帶來很多快樂。
sentences.en: Night markets bring people a lot of joy.

sentences.zh: 這個工作給我帶來很大的壓力。
sentences.en: This job brings me a lot of pressure.

sentences.zh: 他給大家帶來好消息。
sentences.en: He brought everyone good news.

sentences.zh: 臺灣的生活給我帶來深刻的印象。
sentences.en: Life in Taiwan left a deep impression on me.

sentences.zh: 運動給身體帶來好處。
sentences.en: Exercise brings benefits to the body.

sentences.zh: 這個朋友給我帶來很多幫助。
sentences.en: This friend has brought me a lot of help.

sentences.zh: 這個行李箱裝得下所有的東西。
sentences.en: This suitcase can hold everything.

sentences.zh: 這個房間住得下三個人。
sentences.en: This room can accommodate three people.

sentences.zh: 我吃不下了，太飽了。
sentences.en: I can't eat any more; I'm too full.

sentences.zh: 這個冰箱放不下那麼多菜。
sentences.en: This refrigerator can't hold that many dishes.

sentences.zh: 這個行李箱裝不下所有的紀念品。
sentences.en: This suitcase can't hold all the souvenirs.

sentences.zh: 這間公寓住得下一家人。
sentences.en: This apartment can hold a family.

sentences.zh: 這個桌子坐得下八個人。
sentences.en: This table can seat eight people.

sentences.zh: 我今天吃不下早飯。
sentences.en: I can't eat breakfast today.

sentences.zh: 一般來說，臺灣人七點上班。
sentences.en: Generally speaking, Taiwanese people start work at seven.

sentences.zh: 一般來說，夜市下午才開始營業。
sentences.en: Generally, night markets open only in the afternoon.

sentences.zh: 一般來說，鳳梨酥是很好的紀念品。
sentences.en: Generally, pineapple cakes make good souvenirs.

sentences.zh: 一般來說，外國人覺得臺灣人很熱情。
sentences.en: Generally, foreigners find Taiwanese people warm.

sentences.zh: 一般來說，租金包括水費和電費。
sentences.en: Generally, the rent includes water and electricity bills.

sentences.zh: 一般來說，現代的人比以前忙。
sentences.en: Generally, modern people are busier than before.

sentences.zh: 一般來說，我週末都在家休息。
sentences.en: Generally, I rest at home on weekends.

sentences.zh: 一般來說，道地的小吃比較便宜。
sentences.en: Generally, authentic snacks are cheaper.
